candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - projection information
verified_facts: EA survey data is supplied in OSGB36 British National Grid with elevations above Ordnance Datum Newlyn.
EA states the LiDAR Composite is transformed using the OSTN15 geoid mode.
For time-stamped and point-cloud data the metadata catalogues identify the specific geoid model used for each survey.
EA states surveys carried out after 26 August 2016 use OSGM15.
semantic_limits: A modern OSGM15 rule does not authorize rewriting historic survey heights; survey-specific transformation/geoid lineage must be preserved.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - LiDAR data metadata
verified_facts: EA states index catalogues can be downloaded for its survey products.
The index catalogues include details on the time of year the LiDAR data was collected.
semantic_limits: Catalogue availability alone is not exact tile lineage; the sampled parcel result requires the matching survey/tile metadata entry rather than a generic catalogue date.
